data.description: Responsible for marketing as a student ambassador for the IDEACTIVE JAPAN PROJECT, a business contest organized by five companies—Microsoft, SoftBank, Meta, VISITS, and the IoT Business Co-Creation Lab. Organized events such as the "IDEA CREATION WORKSHOP", a hackathon for elementary school students using Minecraft.
